record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare THUNDER_SHOCK: Mareep (1 star), Flaffy (2 stars), Ampharos (3 stars). The strategy is a shared constant instance: AbilityStrategies[Ability.THUNDER_SHOCK] = thunderShockStrategy, the only instance of the module-private class ThunderShockStrategy; the same instance is also cast by Unown's Hidden Power, which this record does not cover. Units sharing the identifier but not listed are not covered.

dispatch.strategy: ThunderShockStrategy extends AbilityStrategy (module-private; exported only as the constant)

record.summary: Needs a target. After the PP spend, deals one special hit to the target of raw 30/60/120/240 by caster stars (AP-scaled, crit possible via the passed crit flag). No status, movement or area effect.

targeting.who: the single target passed to the cast
targeting.note: No cone or area; only the target argument is hit.

geometry.shape: single target; no cone, line or area

effects.scaling: requested = raw table value by the caster's stars. handleSpecialDamage with the default apBoost true: x(1 + caster AP/100); DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2 and strange-steam x1.2 where present; x(1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction) when the crit flag is true (reduction 0 against a Rocky Helmet, -0.1 per Black Augurite of the target's player, floor 0). No rounding before the defence step.
effects.resolution: requested (raw table) -> applied (after AP / crit / multipliers) -> PokemonState.handleDamage: attacker-side multipliers, SPE_DEF division, min-1 floor (core-mechanics section A), shield first then HP; takenDamage = shield damage + min(residual, current HP), rounded (the return value is unused by this strategy). Blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0; a magic bounce may reflect damage to the caster unless it holds Protective Pads). Dead or resurrecting targets take nothing.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (stars - 1); the 240 entry is not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond having a target; the cast range follows the unit's range, which this record does not interpret.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. The strategy object is shared (one instance) but holds no fields.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: special damage 30/60/120 for the listed units' stars. Requested damage = raw; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor etc.; takenDamage (unused here) = what handleDamage reports after SPE_DEF, the min-1 floor, shield and HP cap, rounded.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition) - only the abilities base class was read
Crit resolution - only the crit parameter passed into handleSpecialDamage was read
